FROM DIGITAL-FIRST TO AN OMNICHANNEL BUSINESS One of the most important phases in the Company's growth journey has been the transition from a predominantly digital-first business model towards a broader omnichannel fashion business.
Accordingly, its omnichannel strategy remains central to its long-term growth plans.

EXPANSION OF PHYSICAL RETAIL PRESENCE During FY 2025 -26, the Company made significant progress in expanding and strengthening its physical retail footprint, marking an important phase in the transformation of Jaipur Kurti from a digital-first ethnic wear brand into a diversified, national omni channel fashion brand.
